description: Finalize a local file upload started with upload_file_start. Call this only AFTER the upload command (or, for an image, the curl PUT) has finished successfully. Pass exactly one of: asset_id (a video: verifies every part landed in storage and starts video processing) or image_url (an image). An image creates the asset here - at the team's top level, in folder_id, or as a new version of version_of - titled title. Safe to retry: a repeat returns the same asset.

asset_id.description: The asset_id (version id) upload_file_start returned for a video

files.description: Image only (a video's go with upload_file_start). Files to attach to the version, sent with the upload: by convention the working files that made it as ONE source.zip (the project folder without node_modules, build output or renders; over 30 MB, split into source-1.zip, source-2.zip, ...). Max 30 MB each, 20 per version, names used once. Each comes back with its upload command: run it before the main upload.

content_type.description: MIME type (default application/zip for .zip, else application/octet-stream)

name.description: File name as it will be downloaded, e.g. source.zip

folder_id.description: Image only: folder to create it in (omit for the team's top level)

image_url.description: The image_url upload_file_start returned for an image

notes.description: Image only (a video's go with upload_file_start). The version's notes, in Markdown: what changed and why (link the feedback it answers), and how to continue (the tools, the command that renders it). Saved with the version, so it shows them from the start; each file's line is put above them for you. Up to 20,000 characters of text.

team_id.description: Team to act in: the team.id an earlier result named. Omit for the team selected in the Flask app (which the user can switch at any time).

title.description: Image only: title for the new asset (defaults to the file name for an image)

version_of.description: Image only: add it as a new version of this asset (any of its ids). For a video it is ignored: the version is attached at upload_file_start.

name: upload_file_complete
title: Finish local file upload
